summary: The unchanged custom-game induction exceeded its 240-second deadline with optional fun-arrays SMT encoding. Its literal regression pins the custom-game model, complete _inductive candidate, default encoding, four-step setting and original 240000 ms deadline. Caching value parameters before native induction also exceeded that deadline; the original source proved initialization, preservation and every safety implication in 203929 ms. Default native induction now uses the original source; bounded and supported array checks keep equivalent caching. The complete chess package check still exceeds its 600-second CI task budget, so release verification remains blocked.
